description: This file defines a set of React components for a customizable menu UI, wrapping primitives from '@base-ui/react/menu' and adding styling and structure for menu triggers, popups, groups, items, checkboxes, radio groups, labels, separators, shortcuts, submenus, and related elements.

methods.name: MenuTrigger
methods.description: React component rendering a menu trigger element, passing className and children, with additional props.

methods.name: MenuPopup
methods.description: React component rendering a menu popup with positioning, styling, and children elements.

methods.name: MenuGroup
methods.description: React component for grouping menu items.

methods.name: MenuItem
methods.description: React component for a menu item, supporting variants and styling.

methods.name: MenuCheckboxItem
methods.description: React component for a checkbox menu item, supporting switch variant.

methods.name: MenuRadioGroup
methods.description: React component for a radio button group within the menu.

methods.name: MenuRadioItem
methods.description: React component for a radio menu item.

methods.name: MenuGroupLabel
methods.description: React component for a label within a menu group.

methods.name: MenuSeparator
methods.description: React component for a separator line in the menu.

methods.name: MenuShortcut
methods.description: React component for displaying keyboard shortcuts.

methods.name: MenuSub
methods.description: React component for a submenu root.

methods.name: MenuSubTrigger
methods.description: React component for triggering a submenu.

methods.name: MenuSubPopup
methods.description: React component for a submenu popup, extending MenuPopup with specific positioning.
